summary.intent: Work through the callisto repo's NEXT-WORK plan (v1 hardening): start parallel lanes of fixes, refactors, docs and CI hygiene as separate worktrees and PRs, and keep going until the plan is done.
summary.outcome: Opened a large set of PRs, each with local `just ci` passing: SYS-RETRY fix #202, tests #203, docs #204, init/template/NAPI stack #205-#208, R3 derive split, CI hygiene #271 (hosted CI green), E317 #272, and PRs for pre-mode, range hard-stop, dist-tag/snapshot, dead-code removal, status/failed-command tail, canonical emission and CLI args. Edition 2024 migration was in progress with CI running. PR #201 was closed after the user objected to tracking a local plan file in a PR.

repo: Local tracking/handoff plans must never go in a commit or PR; callisto keeps them at .claude/plans/NEXT-WORK.md, excluded via .git/info/exclude.
Callisto is already lockstep: four published crates (callisto-model MIT, manifests, graph, cli FSL) in one fixed group; consolidation shipped in #157; libraries are to be marked internal at 1.0.
AGENTS.md says no session link in commits or PRs; commits are signed.
Release harness fakes (gh, cargo, registry) can hide bugs, so use real tools or binaries where possible (real jq and binary for NAPI test).
Generated workflow templates are .tmpl files under callisto-graph/src/templates; the matrix snapshot must be updated when they change.
Changesets are required for user-visible changes; test-only and docs-only PRs skip them.
Package references in config and CLI args now require the qualified `eco/name` form (E317); new error codes E317-E319 were added in docs/errors.md.
macOS bash lacks `mapfile`; the template needs a portable loop.

code.finding: Selection now treats a package whose version is tagged at HEAD as resumable and observes all operations before settling; a tag on an older commit settles without provider contact.
Tag inspection must read only the object type, since multi-paragraph or signed tag messages made the old for-each-ref parsing error.
Split into stage functions behind characterization snapshots that were verified by mutation; uploads_by_package moved into OpIndex to satisfy clippy.
The intent omits artifactSlots when empty, so `.artifactSlots[]` iterates null; napi roster is now derived per intent package via `callisto matrix`.

workflow: Read the log's own `exit=` line rather than the background task wrapper's exit code; the wrapper reported 0 while fmt-check had failed.
Write the failing reproduction first, and prove characterization tests can fail via mutation before relying on them.
Sandbox rejects inline env commands, heredocs, and scripts mentioning git, so use script files and the Edit/Write tools; edits are limited to the current worktree.
Scripted bulk conversions can alter unrelated lines (two comments were corrupted); always review the staged diff.
Use separate worktrees per lane and stack dependent PRs with gh stack link.

friction: User had to correct the assistant for putting the local NEXT-WORK plan in PR #201.
Sandbox restrictions on inline env, heredocs and git-mentioning scripts forced workarounds throughout.
Background sessions couldn't edit the shared checkout's plan file, so status recording was lost at one point.
Wrapper exit codes were misleading versus the real log exit lines.
Rebases hit errors.md conflicts repeatedly because several PRs add error codes.
Scripted test conversion double-prefixed names and corrupted comments, requiring fixups.
Compound shell commands were rejected by the guard.
open_items: W0 branch cleanup: ~35 local branches plus remote docs/next-work-plan, docs/spec-rewrite, fix/native-resolution need per-branch user decisions before deletion.
W1 real-service credential check needs a decision on where it runs in CI.
D01 decision blocks SYS-MATURIN and W9; W10 needs two decisions (distinct target graph edges, Python dev group cascade).
W11 verification needs credentials and an approved run.
#202 independent review findings were addressed in part but a merged review is still pending; #204 needs a follow-up for T08-RETRY entries once #202 merges.
cargo-semver-checks deferred until the promised 1.0 surfaces are chosen; merging callisto-manifests into graph left until after 1.0.
The edition 2024 / resolver 3 PR was awaiting CI and had not been committed or opened.
Lane D SYS-BARRIER and Lane F R1 walk.rs::build, plus W9, remain unstarted.
